# Third-party code

| File | Project | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mp4-muxer.js` | [mp4-muxer](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mp4-muxer) by Vanilagy | 5.2.2 | MIT (`mp4-muxer.LICENSE`) |

`mp4-muxer.js` is the unmodified, non-minified `build/mp4-muxer.js` file of the npm package (`npm pack mp4-muxer@5.2.2`).

Note: the author now recommends its successor, [Mediabunny](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny). Version 5.2.2 still works and has no known vulnerability; a migration can be done later.
